Patch 0.29.18 (Bleed duration sync now stays aligned)

  • Authoritative state now also replicates bleed duration: Authoritative state now also replicates bleed duration so active bleeds can carry truthful remaining time instead of only an on/off bleeding flag.
  • Bleed window detail is now more truthful: This lets local self sync and debuff UI track the real remaining bleed window from server state while keeping the broader debuff-duration rollout incremental and honest.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues one debuff at a time: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by extending status detail replication one debuff at a time, moving from timer-backed crowd control into the next safe server-owned bleed case.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for authoritative bleed duration sync and 0.29.18 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.17 (Stun duration sync now stays aligned)

  • Authoritative state now also replicates stun duration: Authoritative state now also replicates stun duration so active stuns can carry truthful remaining time instead of only an on/off stunned flag.
  • Stun lockout detail is now more truthful: This lets local self sync and debuff UI track the real remaining stun lockout from server state while keeping the broader debuff-duration rollout incremental and honest.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues one debuff at a time: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by extending status detail replication one debuff at a time, following root duration with the next safe timer-backed stun case.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for authoritative stun duration sync and 0.29.17 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.16 (Root duration sync now stays aligned)

  • Authoritative state now also replicates root duration: Authoritative state now also replicates root duration so active roots can carry truthful remaining time instead of only an on/off rooted flag.
  • Root lockout detail is now more truthful: This lets local self sync and debuff UI track the real remaining root lockout from server state while keeping the broader debuff-duration rollout incremental and honest.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues one debuff at a time: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by extending status detail replication one debuff at a time, starting with the cleanest timer-backed root case.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for authoritative root duration sync and 0.29.16 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.15 (Slow factor sync now stays aligned)

  • Authoritative state now also replicates slow factor: Authoritative state now also replicates slow factor so active slows can carry truthful strength data instead of only a boolean on/off signal.
  • Slow debuff detail is now more truthful: This lets the local player sync and debuff tracker show the real slow percentage from server state while still avoiding any invented generic durations for other active debuffs.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues carefully: The 0.29 cleanup line continues with the smallest truthful active-status detail replication slice before broader debuff duration work.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for authoritative slow factor sync and 0.29.15 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.14 (Debuff delta sync now stays aligned)

  • Server delta snapshots now track debuff booleans: Server delta snapshots now track stunned, slowed, rooted, bleeding, and poisoned state changes so status-only transitions cannot be skipped by compressed authoritative updates.
  • Status flips now arrive promptly: This keeps the new local debuff-clear path and any remote status consumers supplied with timely authoritative debuff flips instead of relying on unrelated movement or stat changes to carry them through.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues on the server side: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by tightening the server delta broadcaster before any broader status duration replication work.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for debuff flag delta tracking and 0.29.14 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.13 (Authoritative local debuff clears now stay aligned)

  • Local self sync now clears stale debuff state when the server says it is gone: Local authoritative self sync now clears stale debuff timers and stacks when server state explicitly says stun, slow, root, bleed, or poison are no longer active.
  • Debuff truth no longer lingers after authoritative removal: This keeps the local buff tracker and control-state truth from lingering after authoritative status removal without pretending to know missing server-side durations for still-active debuffs.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues carefully: The 0.29 cleanup line continues with a narrow status-model correction that is safe to ship before any broader timer replication redesign.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for authoritative local debuff clears and 0.29.13 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.12 (Local authoritative unlocked talent sync now stays aligned)

  • Local self sync now applies unlocked talent truth during delta updates: Local authoritative self sync now also stores server-sent unlocked talent lists during delta updates instead of treating that field as a change trigger without ever applying it.
  • Talent progression state stays aligned with authoritative player updates: This keeps the local progression state aligned when authoritative player updates include talent unlocks alongside ranks and points, closing one more small split in the talent sync path.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by making local authoritative progression sync more internally complete before any broader status-model work.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative unlocked talent sync and 0.29.12 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.11 (Local authoritative skill rune sync now stays aligned)

  • Local self sync now applies skill rune truth during delta updates: Local authoritative self sync now also applies server-sent skill rune selections during delta updates instead of relying only on the separate rune message or a later full-state refresh.
  • Rune-driven behavior stays aligned with authoritative player state: This keeps rune-driven skill behavior and UI truth aligned when authoritative player updates already contain the latest rune loadout, closing another small split path in the local progression sync flow.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by making the local authoritative player path more internally complete across both combat state and progression customisation.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative skill rune sync and 0.29.11 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.10 (Local authoritative charge state now stays aligned)

  • Local self sync now applies charge-state truth: Local authoritative self sync now also applies server-sent charge state so the local player follows the same authoritative charging flag already used by remote entity sync.
  • Charge behavior no longer depends on stale local state: This keeps local fighter charge behavior, animation selection, and related control-state checks from drifting when the server toggles charging without a separate local prediction path owning the transition.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by closing another emitted-but-not-applied self state flag in the authoritative player sync path.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative charge sync and 0.29.10 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.9 (Local authoritative scale now stays aligned)

  • Local self sync now applies scale truth: Local authoritative self sync now also applies server-sent scale so player size changes use the same authoritative setScale path that remote entities already follow.
  • Player size no longer drifts behind server state: This keeps local range, collision, and visual scale behavior aligned when the server changes player scale instead of leaving the local actor on stale size until some later rebuild.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by closing another emitted-but-not-applied self field in the authoritative player sync path.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative scale sync and 0.29.9 version presentation.
